UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a registered user or contributor to the BharatDarshan Wiki platform. Stores profile information, excluding authentication details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: A unique username chosen by the user for display.

bio.description: A short biographical description provided by the user.

joinDate.description: The date and time when the user registered on the platform.

Language.title: Language
Language.description: Represents a supported language for content and translation within the BharatDarshan Wiki.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Language entity, typically an ISO 639-1 or BCP 47 language code (e.g., 'en', 'hi', 'mr').

name.description: The English name of the language (e.g., 'English', 'Hindi', 'Marathi').

nativeName.description: The name of the language in its native script (e.g., 'हिन्दी', 'मराठी').

State.title: State
State.description: Represents an Indian State, serving as a top-level geographical entity for the BharatDarshan Wiki.

id.description: Unique identifier for the State entity.

name.description: The official name of the state.

slug.description: A URL-friendly identifier for the state, used for dynamic routing.

description.description: A general description or overview of the state.

capital.description: The capital city of the state.

population.description: The population of the state, as an integer.

areaSqKm.description: The total area of the state in square kilometers, as an integer.

mapImageUrl.description: URL to an image depicting the geographical map of the state.

establishedDate.description: The date when the state was officially established or formed.

District.title: District
District.description: Represents a district within an Indian State.

id.description: Unique identifier for the District entity.

name.description: The official name of the district.

slug.description: A URL-friendly identifier for the district, unique within its state.

description.description: A general description or overview of the district.

stateId.description: Reference to the State this district belongs to. (Relationship: State 1:N District)

population.description: The population of the district, as an integer.

areaSqKm.description: The total area of the district in square kilometers, as an integer.

Place.title: Place
Place.description: Represents a specific point of interest, landmark, or location within a district.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Place entity.

name.description: The common name of the place (e.g., 'Taj Mahal', 'Gateway of India').

slug.description: A URL-friendly identifier for the place, unique within its district.

description.description: A brief description of the place.

districtId.description: Reference to the District this place belongs to. (Relationship: District 1:N Place)

latitude.description: Geographical latitude of the place, allowing for decimal values.

longitude.description: Geographical longitude of the place, allowing for decimal values.

type.description: Categorization of the place (e.g., 'Historical Site', 'Religious Place', 'Natural Landmark', 'Museum', 'Beach').

address.description: The physical address of the place.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Represents a broad thematic category for organizing articles (e.g., 'History', 'Culture', 'Geography').

id.description: Unique identifier for the Category entity.

name.description: The name of the category (e.g., 'Ancient Sites', 'National Parks').

description.description: A brief description explaining the scope of the category.

articleIds.description: References to Articles belonging to this category. (Relationship: Category N:N Article)

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: Represents a granular keyword or label used to describe and filter articles (e.g., 'Forts', 'Beaches', 'Cuisine').

id.description: Unique identifier for the Tag entity.

description.description: A brief description explaining the context of the tag.

articleIds.description: References to Articles associated with this tag. (Relationship: Tag N:N Article)

Image.title: Image
Image.description: Represents an image asset used within articles, including metadata and provenance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Image entity.

url.description: The URL where the image file is hosted.

altText.description: Alternative text for the image, crucial for accessibility and SEO.

caption.description: A short caption or description displayed with the image.

uploadedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who uploaded this image. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Image)

uploadDate.description: The date and time when the image was uploaded.

sourceUrl.description: The original source URL of the image, if applicable (e.g., Wikimedia Commons).

articleIds.description: References to Articles where this image is used. (Relationship: Image N:N Article)

Article.title: Article
Article.description: The primary content unit of the BharatDarshan Wiki, representing a detailed article about a State, District, or Place, contributed by users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Article entity.

title.description: The main title of the article.

slug.description: A URL-friendly identifier for the article, unique across all articles for dynamic routing.

content.description: The main rich text content of the article, potentially in HTML or Markdown format.

summary.description: A brief summary or introductory paragraph of the article.

createdAt.description: The date and time when the article was first created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the article was last updated.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who initially created this article. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Article)

lastEditedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who last edited this article. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Article)

status.description: The current status of the article (e.g., 'draft', 'published', 'pending_review', 'archived').

publishDate.description: The date and time when the article was officially published.

stateId.description: Optional reference to a State if the article is primarily about a specific state. (Relationship: State 0..1:N Article)

districtId.description: Optional reference to a District if the article is primarily about a specific district. (Relationship: District 0..1:N Article)

placeId.description: Optional reference to a Place if the article is primarily about a specific point of interest. (Relationship: Place 0..1:N Article)

imageIds.description: References to Images used within this article. (Relationship: Article N:N Image)

tagIds.description: References to Tags associated with this article. (Relationship: Article N:N Tag)

categoryIds.description: References to Categories this article belongs to. (Relationship: Article N:N Category)

ArticleRevision.title: ArticleRevision
ArticleRevision.description: Records historical versions of an article, enabling a 'Wikipedia-like history version' feature for tracking changes and allowing rollbacks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ArticleRevision entity.

articleId.description: Reference to the Article this revision belongs to. (Relationship: Article 1:N ArticleRevision)

revisionNumber.description: An incremental number representing the version of the article within its revision history.

content.description: The full content of the article at this specific revision.

summary.description: The summary of the article at this specific revision.

editedByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who made this revision. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ArticleRevision)

editedAt.description: The date and time when this revision was made.

changeSummary.description: A brief description provided by the editor summarizing the changes made in this revision.

Translation.title: Translation
Translation.description: Stores AI-generated or manually refined translations of articles into various supported languages, enhancing accessibility.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Translation entity.

articleId.description: Reference to the original Article that was translated. (Relationship: Article 1:N Translation)

languageId.description: Reference to the Language this article is translated into. (Relationship: Language 1:N Translation)

translatedTitle.description: The translated title of the article in the target language.

translatedContent.description: The full translated content of the article in the target language.

translatedSummary.description: The translated summary of the article in the target language.

translatedByUserId.description: Optional reference to the UserProfile who reviewed or manually edited this translation. If purely AI-generated, this can be null. (Relationship: UserProfile 0..1:N Translation)

translationTimestamp.description: The date and time when this translation was generated or last updated.

sourceLanguageId.description: Reference to the original Language of the article from which this translation was made. (Relationship: Language 1:N Translation)

AISuggestion.title: AISuggestion
AISuggestion.description: Stores AI-generated suggestions for content improvement, summarization, or fact-checking, aiding contributors in refining articles.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AISuggestion entity.

articleId.description: Reference to the Article to which this suggestion applies. (Relationship: Article 1:N AISuggestion)

revisionId.description: Optional reference to a specific ArticleRevision this suggestion pertains to, if the suggestion is tied to a particular version of the article. (Relationship: ArticleRevision 0..1:N AISuggestion)

suggestedText.description: The AI's proposed new text, summary, or specific content improvement.

suggestionType.description: The type of suggestion provided by the AI (e.g., 'content_improvement', 'summarization', 'fact_check', 'grammar_correction', 'SEO_optimization').

targetField.description: Indicates which field of the article (e.g., 'title', 'content', 'summary') the AI suggestion targets.

originalTextSnippet.description: A snippet of the original text from the article that the AI suggestion is meant to replace or improve.

suggestedBy.description: Identifier of the AI model or service that generated the suggestion (e.g., 'Gemini AI').

suggestedAt.description: The date and time when the AI suggestion was generated.

isApplied.description: A boolean flag indicating whether the suggestion has been incorporated or applied to the article's content by a user.

appliedByUserId.description: Optional reference to the UserProfile who applied this suggestion. (Relationship: UserProfile 0..1:N AISuggestion)

appliedAt.description: The date and time when the suggestion was applied to the article.

acceptanceStatus.description: The current status of the suggestion (e.g., 'pending', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'partially_accepted').

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. Path-based ownership (`userId`) ensures privacy and simplifies security rules for user profile management. Users can read/write their own profile data. Basic profile info might be publicly readable for contributor listings.

Denormalized collection for global administrator roles. The existence of a document at this path signifies that the corresponding user (identified by `userId`) is an admin, enabling robust role-based access control without custom claims.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who holds the admin role.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for BharatDarshan Wiki prioritizes security, scalability, and debuggability by strictly adhering to the core design principles. This design employs **Structural Segregation** and **Authorization Independence via Denormalization** to ensure robust and easily maintainable security rules.

**Authorization Independence:**

1.  **User Profiles and Roles:** `users/{userId}` ensures path-based ownership for user profiles, making rules simple (`request.auth.uid == userId`). A dedicated `roles_admin/{userId}` collection uses document existence to grant admin privileges, avoiding `get()` calls for role checks.
2.  **Core Content (States, Districts, Places, Languages, Categories, Tags):** These entities are designed as globally readable, master data in root collections (`/states`, `/districts`, etc.). Write access will be restricted to authenticated administrators, whose role is checked via the independent `/roles_admin/{userId}` collection. No authorization denormalization is needed within these collections themselves as their primary access posture is public read.
3.  **Articles:** The `Article` entity in `/articles/{articleId}` uses its `status` field (`published`, `draft`, `pending_review`) and `createdByUserId` for authorization. Public articles (`status == 'published'`) are globally readable. Drafts are restricted to `createdByUserId`. This leverages queryable fields and avoids `get()` calls for parent data.
4.  **Dependent Content (ArticleRevision, Translation, AISuggestion):** These subcollections (`/articles/{articleId}/revisions`, `/articles/{articleId}/translations`, `/articles/{articleId}/aiSuggestions`) inherently depend on the parent `Article`'s status and ownership. To achieve **Authorization Independence**, each document in these subcollections will denormalize critical authorization context from its parent `Article`. Specifically, `articleStatus` (e.g., 'published', 'draft') and `articleCreatedByUserId` will be copied into every `ArticleRevision`, `Translation`, and `AISuggestion` document. This allows security rules for these subcollections to evaluate access rights solely based on the `resource.data` of the document being accessed, eliminating costly and complex `get()` calls to the parent article and enabling atomic operations (like creating an article and its first revision in a batch).

**Queryable Authorization Patterns (QAPs):**

1.  **Public Content:** Collections like `/states`, `/districts`, `/places`, `/languages`, `/categories`, `/tags`, and `articles` with `status: 'published'` are designed for efficient public `list` queries without security rule filters. Their documents are inherently public.
2.  **User-Specific Content:** `users/{userId}` and `articles` with `status: 'draft'` (filtered by `createdByUserId`) allow authenticated users to `list` and manage their private content using direct `request.auth.uid` checks against document fields or path segments.
3.  **Dependent Content:** By denormalizing `articleStatus` and `articleCreatedByUserId` into `ArticleRevision`, `Translation`, and `AISuggestion` documents, `list` operations on these subcollections can be secured and made efficient. For example, a user can query their own draft translations by filtering on `articleCreatedByUserId` and `articleStatus`, or public translations by filtering on `articleStatus == 'published'`, without the rules becoming filters.

This architecture minimizes rule complexity, prevents security vulnerabilities arising from `get()` dependencies, and ensures high performance for both reads and writes, crucial for a collaborative, content-rich platform like BharatDarshan Wiki.
